text.text: Every layout, sizing, and constraint value. Resize a parent to see fill, min, max, and constraints move.
Wide content — shift+wheel or horizontal scrollbar; arrows, track, thumb, keys, and drag also scroll.
fill, stroke, radius, opacity, rotation, visible, locked
rectangle — one shape with its own fill, stroke, and a radius at every corner
the outline takes a pattern — dash 6 4, or one number whose gap comes from dashGap
text — the box a block covers, and the case and the line it is drawn in
auto width — one line, hugging it
auto height — width given, height grows
This line wraps into two lines, so the box grows down to hold both.
fixed — the size it was given
Fixed size, wrapped inside the box it was given.
a line height the font decides, a case, and a line drawn through the run
rich text — one paragraph of runs, broken and drawn as a single line, each word set with the values it wrote
runs of one paragraph: the text of the block, then a run per word
the runs wrap together: the word that does not fit begins the next line

richtext.name: Wrapped
richtext.text: A paragraph of runs breaks across

text.text: a run takes what it did not write from the block around it

span.name: Asked
span.text: where the run asked for it.

text.text: image — a picture in a box: how it is fitted into the box, the region of the file that is drawn, and the look it is washed with
contain — fitted whole inside the box, centred
cover + clip — fills the box and is cut off at it
crop + tint + flip — a region of the file, washed blue and mirrored
a picture that names a file nobody keeps is still a box, named after the file, so the gap shows where it stands
boolean — one shape computed from the shapes it holds, in the group's own fill
subtract — the square less the circle
exclude — the parts only one covers
a group strokes its own combined outline, so a pattern follows the combined shape
ellipse — two radii from one box, so a square box is a circle
vector — a shape whose outline is a path: written in a view box, drawn in the box
an imported icon: paths, no slab
art scales with the box: one path, two icons
svg — art written into the document, path by path, or read from a file the node names
the art, written in the document: every path is a layer
the same art, read from a file, at the size it was drawn for
one file, drawn in another colour, at another size, and turned
star — a polygon whose ring holds two radii: a point, then a valley, all the way round
polygon — a rectangle with a different outline: as many sides as it is given, and a radius to round them
line — two endpoints with a cap, a width, and an optional dash pattern
arrow — a line with a head, so every line property still applies to it
group — combine objects into one node; set a property once and every child follows
